title: Senior Business Development Executive
description:
***Senior Business Development Executive (BDE) – International Clients (US Market)***

**Full-Time | Remote after Initial Training | US Working Hours | Monday to Saturday**

Monthly Take-Home Salary: ₹25,000 – ₹37,000

**+ Performance-Based Incentives**

We are hiring on behalf of a growing organisation serving international clients, primarily in the **United States**.

We are looking for a confident, highly articulate and client-focused professional who can communicate comfortably with international customers, conduct discovery and sales conversations, manage client relationships, follow up consistently, and convert opportunities into long-term business.

This is **not a back-office or chat-only position**.

You will regularly speak with overseas clients, including senior professionals and decision-makers. Therefore, **excellent spoken English, professional communication and prior experience handling foreign clients are essential for this role.**

**Key ResponsibilitiesInternational Client Communication & Lead Conversion**

* Communicate with prospective and existing international clients through calls, email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp and online meetings.
* Contact warm leads and interested prospects promptly and schedule discovery or consultation calls.
* Conduct professional discovery calls to understand the client's requirements, objectives and challenges.
* Explain the company's services confidently and clearly.
* Follow up with interested prospects and convert qualified opportunities into clients.
* Re-engage prospects who previously showed interest but did not proceed.
* Maintain consistent and professional communication throughout the sales process.

**Client Onboarding & Relationship Management**

* Manage the onboarding process for new clients from initial confirmation through successful service activation.
* Ensure clients understand the process, timelines, expectations and next steps.
* Maintain regular communication with clients throughout their journey.
* Build professional relationships and become a reliable point of contact for assigned accounts.
* Identify concerns early and work internally to resolve them.
* Support client retention by ensuring customers continue to understand and receive value from the service.
* Identify appropriate upselling or account-growth opportunities without using aggressive sales tactics.

**Business Development & Outreach**

* Identify potential international prospects using LinkedIn and other available databases.
* Conduct personalised outreach through LinkedIn, email and WhatsApp.
* Write professional messages suitable for senior professionals and international decision-makers.
* Follow structured outreach processes, templates and sales playbooks provided during training.
* Maintain regular follow-ups instead of allowing potential opportunities to go cold.

**Pipeline Management & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate records of prospects, calls, follow-ups, conversions and client status.
* Ensure every lead has a clear next action and follow-up date.
* Share regular updates regarding pipeline activity, client feedback, objections and conversion performance.
* Work independently and take ownership of assigned leads and accounts.

**Who We Are Looking For**

The ideal candidate should have:

* **Excellent spoken English communication skills — mandatory.**
* Strong written English with the ability to write professional emails and messages.
* Previous experience communicating with **foreign/international clients — mandatory and highly important for this position.**
* Experience handling clients from the **US, UK, Canada, Australia, Europe or other international markets** will be strongly preferred.
* Confidence speaking with senior professionals and decision-makers.
* Previous experience in **Business Development, Inside Sales, Client Success, Account Management, Customer Success, Client Servicing, International Sales or a similar client-facing role.**
* Strong persuasion, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to communicate naturally rather than sounding like someone reading from a script.
* Strong follow-up discipline.
* Good organisational and time-management skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple conversations and client accounts.
* Comfortable working with tools such as LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, Zoom/Google Meet and basic CRM or lead trackers.
* Stable internet connectivity and a professional working environment at home after completion of training.

**Communication Standards**

Because this role involves regular interaction with international clients, communication quality will be one of the most important selection criteria.

**You should be able to:**

* Speak English fluently and confidently.
* Understand different international accents.
* Conduct a complete professional conversation independently.
* Ask relevant questions instead of only following a fixed script.
* Explain services clearly and handle objections professionally.
* Write grammatically correct and professional emails/messages.
* Build rapport with international clients while maintaining professional boundaries.

**Candidates with weak spoken English or no experience dealing with international customers may not be suitable for this position.**

Working Days

**Monday to Saturday**

**Sunday: Weekly Off**

This is a **6-day working role**.

Candidates should apply only if they are comfortable working Monday through Saturday on a long-term basis.

Working Hours – US Shift

The position follows **US business hours**.

Typical working hours will align approximately with:

**8:30 AM – 5:30 PM US Eastern Time**

Because the United States follows Daylight Saving Time, the corresponding India timings may change during the year.

The shift will generally fall around:

**6:00 PM – 3:00 AM IST during US Daylight Saving Time**

and approximately:

**7:00 PM – 4:00 AM IST during US Standard Time**

Candidates must be comfortable working these hours consistently.

Salary & US Hours AllowanceTake-Home Salary:

**₹25,000 – ₹37,000 per month**

**The final salary will depend on:**

* Relevant experience
* Previous international-client exposure
* Spoken English and communication assessment
* Sales/client-handling ability
* Interview performance

The compensation structure will include a **US Hours / Late Shift Allowance**, proportionate to the final salary offered.

As a general structure, approximately **₹4,000 – ₹6,000 per month** of the compensation may be allocated toward the US-hours shift allowance, depending on the candidate's final salary level and experience.

**The total committed monthly take-home compensation will remain within ₹25,000 – ₹37,000.**

Performance-based incentives may be offered additionally based on achievement of defined targets.

Detailed salary breakup and incentive structure will be communicated to shortlisted candidates during the offer process.

**Training & Work Location**

The selected candidate will undergo an initial **one-week in-person training programme in Thane, Maharashtra**.

**The training will cover:**

* Company services
* Client communication
* Sales and discovery calls
* Outreach process
* Scripts and objection handling
* Client onboarding
* Internal systems and tools
* Account management expectations

After successful completion of the training period, the position will transition to a **remote/work-from-home setup**, subject to company policy and performance requirements.

Required work equipment will be provided as applicable for the role.

**Probation Period**

There will be a **3-month probation period**.

Performance, communication quality, attendance, professionalism, target achievement and overall suitability for the position will be reviewed during probation.

Leave Benefits

**Paid Leave and Sick Leave benefits will become applicable after successful completion of the 3-month probation period**, as per company policy.

**Holiday Policy**

Since this position works with the US market, the role will follow the organisation's **US holiday calendar**.

**US holidays, as applicable under the company holiday calendar, will be observed.**

Indian public holidays should **not automatically be considered holidays for this position** unless specifically declared by the organisation.

All Sundays will remain weekly offs.

Service Commitment

This position carries a **16-month service commitment/bond**.

Candidates should apply only if they are looking for a stable role and are comfortable making a medium-to-long-term commitment to the organisation.

Complete terms and conditions relating to the service commitment will be clearly communicated to the candidate before acceptance of the final employment offer.

**What You Can Expect**

* Direct exposure to international clients.
* Opportunity to regularly communicate with professionals from the US and other global markets.
* Structured sales and client-management training.
* Professional scripts, outreach frameworks and objection-handling support.
* International business-development experience.
* Opportunity to develop client success, account management and consultative selling skills.
* Performance-linked earning opportunities.
* Remote working after successful completion of initial training.
* Opportunity to grow into senior client growth, account management or team-lead responsibilities based on performance.

**This Role Is Best Suited For Someone Who**

Enjoys speaking with people, communicates extremely well in English, is comfortable with sales and client conversations, follows up without being reminded, understands professional etiquette, wants exposure to international business and is willing to work consistently during US hours.

We value **communication ability, attitude, consistency, international-client handling experience and ownership** more than impressive job titles.

Please Apply Only If You Are Comfortable With

* **₹25,000 – ₹37,000 monthly take-home salary**
* **US working hours / night shift**
* **Monday to Saturday working**
* **Sunday weekly off**
* **US holiday calendar**
* **3-month probation period**
* Leave benefits beginning after probation
* **One-week or Two week initial in-person training in Thane**
* Remote work after successful training
* Client-facing sales and account-management responsibilities
* Daily professional communication with international clients
* **16-month service commitment/bond**

Candidates who are not comfortable with the above conditions are requested not to apply.

**Candidates may be required to complete a short spoken-English and client-conversation assessment as part of the interview process.**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

Regional Commodity Manager - Liquid Cooling - CDU Coolant Distribution Unit

**LOCATION**

Thane, India / Regional Scope

**EXPERIENCE**

8-12 years

  

**EDUCATION**

Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering

**FUNCTION**

Strategic Sourcing / Commodity Management

Position Summary

The Regional Commodity Manager for Liquid cooling CDU is responsible for developing and executing regional sourcing strategies for Electro-mechanical Commodity like - Pump/VFD/PHE/Controller/SS Piping/Flow Control Valve/Electrical components/Sensors/VFD/Electrical Panel etc. Proven experience in handling contract manufacturing and outsourcing business within strategic sourcing.

This role will strengthen supplier competitiveness, optimize total cost, protect continuity of supply and support business growth across project-based and operational requirements.

The position serves as the primary commercial interface between CDU suppliers and internal stakeholders, including Engineering, Quality, Operations, Logistics, Sales, Product Management and Global Procurement. The successful candidate will combine Mechanical product knowledge with strong strategic sourcing, negotiation and supplier-management capabilities.

Key Responsibilities 1. Commodity Strategy and Strategic Sourcing

* Develop and execute regional commodity strategies for Electro-Mechanical Commodity like – Pump/PHE/Controller/SS Piping/Flow Control Valve/Electrical components/Sensors/SS Fittings/VFD/Electrical Panel etc.
* Align regional plans with global commodity direction, business objectives, technology roadmaps and customer requirements.
* Stainless Steel supplier market scans, RFIs, RFQs, e-sourcing events, bid evaluations, negotiations and sourcing recommendations.
* Identify, qualify and onboard competitive suppliers, including localization and alternate-source opportunities.
* Build should-cost, total-cost-of-ownership and price-benchmarking models to support sourcing decisions.

2. Supplier Relationship and Performance Management

* Establish strategic relationships with manufacturers, system integrators and key sub-tier suppliers.
* Conduct regular supplier business reviews covering quality, cost, delivery, capacity, technology, service and sustainability.
* Develop corrective and improvement plans for underperforming suppliers and track actions to closure.
* Coordinate supplier development with Quality and Engineering to improve process capability, reliability and responsiveness.

3. Cost, Productivity and Commercial Management

* Deliver annual productivity and cost-reduction programs through negotiation, value engineering, localization, resourcing, specification optimization and supplier consolidation.
* Monitor key cost drivers.
* Negotiate commercial agreements, pricing mechanisms, warranties, payment terms, lead times, logistics models and service obligations.
* Maintain contract coverage and ensure sourcing decisions comply with delegated authority and procurement governance.

4. Supply Continuity and Risk Management

* Assess supplier capacity, financial health, geographic concentration, logistics exposure, sub-tier dependency and raw-material risks.
* Create and maintain mitigation plans, including dual sourcing, safety-stock arrangements, local warehousing, capacity reservation and business-continuity actions.
* Partner with planning, operations and suppliers to resolve shortages, expedite critical requirements and protect customer commitments.
* Monitor market developments and provide timely risk and opportunity updates to leadership.

5. Cross-Functional and Technical Collaboration

* Engage early in new product introduction, customer proposals and engineering change activities to ensure competitive and supply-ready solutions.
* Work with Engineering and Quality on specifications, supplier qualification, testing, approvals, reliability, warranty and failure-resolution activities.
* Support standardization and rationalization of makes, models and configurations across business units and sites.
* Coordinate with Sales and Product Management to understand pipeline, project timing, technology needs and regional customer expectations.

6. Sustainability, Compliance and Governance

* Ensure suppliers comply with applicable environmental, health and safety, trade, ethical sourcing and regulatory requirements.
* Promote responsible sourcing, recycling, end-of-life management, safe transportation and reduced environmental impact.
* Maintain accurate sourcing records, approvals, contracts, supplier data and audit documentation.

7. Analytics and Reporting

* Maintain commodity dashboards covering spend, savings, quality, delivery, lead time, inventory, contract coverage and supplier risk.
* Prepare periodic commodity reviews, executive updates and sourcing pipeline reports.
* Use data to identify supply-base, working-capital, cost and service improvement opportunities.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering.
* 8-12 years of experience in strategic sourcing, commodity management, procurement, supplier development or supply chain roles.
* Demonstrated experience sourcing of Mechanical products/Components.
* Experience working in a project-based, engineered-to-order or high-mix, low-volume business environment is preferred.
* Strong commercial negotiation, contract management, analytical and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to read and interpret drawings specifications, drawings, data sheets, test requirements and supplier technical proposals.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP/procurement systems; experience with Power BI or similar analytics tools is preferred.
* Fluent business English and willingness to travel regionally/globally as required.

Key Performance Indicators

* Cost savings and productivity delivery
* Supplier on-time delivery and lead-time improvement
* Supplier quality and corrective-action closure
* Localization and alternate-source implementation
* Contract coverage and sourcing compliance
* Inventory and working-capital improvement
* Supplier risk reduction and continuity readiness
* Project sourcing milestones and stakeholder satisfaction
* ESG and supplier-compliance performance

Preferred Industry Exposure

Candidates with sourcing or engineering exposure in the following sectors will be preferred:

* Thermal/HVAC/Liquid cooling
* Data centers/ Large Infra companies/Turnkey Project
* Manufacturing thermal cooling equipment
* Oil & Gas/Energy/petrochemical/ Heavy Fabrication
* Automobile

Role Success Profile

The ideal candidate is a technically credible and commercially strong sourcing professional who can translate business demand into a clear commodity strategy, create competitive supplier options and deliver measurable improvements in cost, quality, delivery and supply resilience. The person should be comfortable operating across regional and global teams, managing ambiguity and influencing decisions without direct authority.

**Note:** *The responsibilities and qualifications may be adjusted based on business needs, regional scope and organizational structure.*

title: Import Customer Service Executive
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION-**Import Customer Service Executive – Air & Sea Freight**

**Company:** Azimar Shipping & Logistics LLP  
**Job Location:** CBD Belapur, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Department:** Import Customer Service & Operations  
**Experience Required:** Minimum 5 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | Work from Office  
**Industry:** Freight Forwarding, Shipping & Logistics  
**Reporting To:** Import Operations Manager / Management

About Azimar Shipping & Logistics LLP

Azimar Shipping & Logistics LLP is a growing international freight forwarding and logistics company with a strong presence across India and its own overseas operations in the UAE, Kuwait and other international markets.

As part of our continued expansion, we are looking for an experienced and highly motivated **Import Customer Service Executive – Air & Sea Freight** to join our CBD Belapur office in Navi Mumbai.

1. Job Purpose

The selected candidate will be responsible for independently managing **end-to-end air and sea import shipments, from customer enquiry, freight quotation and booking confirmation to shipment tracking, documentation, customs clearance, final delivery and billing coordination.**

The role requires strong knowledge of international freight forwarding procedures, Indian Customs regulations, import documentation, overseas agent coordination and customer service.

The ideal candidate should be capable of handling multiple shipments independently, ensuring timely quotation responses, smooth operations, customer satisfaction and shipment profitability.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Import Enquiries & Freight Quotations

* Receive and handle air and sea import enquiries from customers, sales executives and overseas network agents.
* Review shipment details, including origin, destination, commodity, HS code, gross weight, dimensions, CBM, Incoterms and delivery requirements.
* Obtain competitive freight rates from overseas agents, airlines, shipping lines, NVOCCs and co-loaders.
* Prepare accurate and competitive air and sea import quotations covering freight, destination charges, customs clearance, transportation and applicable expenses.
* Ensure timely quotation submission as per company standards:
* **Air Freight:** Within 3–4 hours.
* **Sea Freight:** Before the end of the same working day.
* Follow up on quotations with customers and sales teams to improve conversion.
* Maintain accurate enquiry and quotation records.

B. Air Freight Import Operations

* Independently coordinate air import shipments from booking confirmation to final delivery.
* Liaise with overseas agents and airlines for flight schedules, routing, cargo uplift and pre-alerts.
* Verify MAWB, HAWB, commercial invoices, packing lists and other import documents.
* Monitor shipment departures, transshipments, arrival schedules and possible offloading.
* Coordinate with airlines, ground handling agents and airport cargo terminals.
* Arrange Delivery Orders and coordinate customs clearance with appointed Customs Brokers.
* Monitor cargo clearance and airport storage charges.
* Arrange transportation and ensure timely cargo delivery.
* Resolve shipment discrepancies, documentation errors, delays and cargo damage issues.
* Handle shipments through Mumbai Air Cargo Complex and other major Indian international airports as required.

C. Sea Freight Import Operations – FCL & LCL

* Handle FCL and LCL import shipments independently from booking confirmation to final delivery.
* Coordinate with overseas agents, shipping lines, NVOCCs and consolidation operators.
* Verify Master Bills of Lading (MBL), House Bills of Lading (HBL), commercial invoices, packing lists and manifests.
* Monitor vessel schedules, transshipments, ETA changes and cargo arrivals.
* Arrange shipping line Delivery Orders and follow up on cargo release.
* Coordinate import customs clearance at Nhava Sheva (JNPT), Mumbai Port and applicable ICD/CFS locations.
* Arrange container transportation, LCL deconsolidation and final delivery.
* Monitor demurrage, detention, container free time and port storage charges.
* Ensure timely empty container returns.
* Handle shipment delays, customs holds and operational escalations.

D. Import Documentation & Customs Clearance Coordination

* Verify all shipping documents before cargo arrival to minimise customs clearance delays.
* Coordinate with Customs Brokers (CHA) for Bill of Entry preparation and filing through ICEGATE/ICES.
* Ensure importers provide valid IEC, GSTIN, KYC and necessary customs authorisations.
* Coordinate submission of invoices, packing lists, AWBs, Bills of Lading, Certificates of Origin and applicable permits.
* Maintain working knowledge of Indian Customs procedures, import duties, IGST and HS classification.
* Coordinate with Customs Brokers for customs examination, assessment, duty payment and Out of Charge.
* Identify shipments requiring BIS, FSSAI, WPC, CDSCO, Plant Quarantine or other regulatory approvals, where applicable.
* Follow up on customs queries, inspections and document amendments.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian Customs and DGFT regulations.

E. Customer Service & Shipment Coordination

* Act as the primary contact for assigned import customers.
* Provide proactive shipment updates at every important milestone.
* Communicate shipment delays, revised ETAs and delivery schedules promptly.
* Coordinate closely with overseas agents, customs brokers, transporters and customers.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer enquiries and operational issues.
* Maintain professional relationships with customers and network partners.
* Ensure all customer emails and shipment requests are responded to promptly.
* Take complete ownership of assigned shipments from enquiry through delivery.

F. Transportation & Final Delivery

* Arrange transportation from airports, seaports, ICDs and CFS facilities to customer locations.
* Coordinate with transport vendors for vehicle availability, competitive rates and delivery schedules.
* Ensure appropriate transport arrangements based on cargo weight, dimensions and commodity.
* Monitor cargo collection, transportation and delivery.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD) and update shipment records.
* Report cargo shortages, damages and delivery discrepancies immediately.
* Coordinate empty container returns within the applicable free time.

G. Overseas Agent & Vendor Coordination

* Maintain effective communication with international freight forwarding agents and logistics network partners.
* Obtain competitive freight buying rates and reliable routing options.
* Follow up on bookings, shipment schedules and documentation.
* Develop professional relationships with airlines, shipping lines, co-loaders, customs brokers and transporters.
* Escalate vendor service failures and shipment delays promptly.
* Maintain updated vendor contacts and freight tariff records.

H. Job Costing, Billing & Profitability

* Prepare accurate shipment job costing.
* Verify freight buying rates and local charges against approved quotations.
* Coordinate with Accounts for timely customer invoicing.
* Check vendor invoices and report discrepancies.
* Monitor shipment profitability and prevent unnecessary expenses.
* Ensure unexpected charges receive management approval.
* Support the Accounts team in resolving billing queries.
* Maintain accurate operational and financial records for assigned shipments.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)Performance AreaTargetAir import quotation turnaroundWithin 3–4 hoursSea import quotation turnaroundSame working dayCustomer enquiry acknowledgementWithin 30 minutesDocumentation accuracy100% targetOn-time cargo deliveryMinimum 95%, subject to agreed service levelsShipment status updatesAt every critical milestoneAvoidable demurrage and storageZero targetCustomer complaint acknowledgementWithin 1 working hourJob costing and billing coordinationWithin 24 hours of job completionQuotation follow-upDailyDaily operational reportMandatoryEnquiry-to-booking conversionTarget 30%, subject to management review4. Daily Reporting Responsibilities

The candidate must maintain an updated daily report covering:

* Customer name and responsible sales executive.
* New air and sea import enquiries received.
* Enquiry receipt date and time.
* Quotation submission date and time.
* Quotation value and current status.
* Confirmed bookings and shipment details.
* Shipments in transit and expected arrivals.
* Shipments awaiting documentation or customs clearance.
* Shipments pending cargo delivery.
* Operational delays and corrective actions.
* Completed deliveries and billing status.
* Shipment profitability and additional expenses.

**All pending enquiries and shipments must be actively followed up. No customer enquiry should remain unattended or be carried forward without a justified reason and escalation.**

5. Qualifications & Experience

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, International Business or a related field.
* Additional certifications in freight forwarding or import/export documentation will be an advantage.

**Experience**

* **Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in an international freight forwarding company.**
* Proven experience handling both air and sea import shipments.
* Strong practical knowledge of FCL, LCL, air cargo import procedures and import documentation.
* Experience coordinating customs clearance at Nhava Sheva (JNPT) and Mumbai Airport.
* Familiarity with ICEGATE, Indian Customs procedures and DGFT regulations.
* Experience handling overseas agents, shipping lines, airlines, customs brokers and transporters.
* Ability to manage import enquiries, quotations and shipments independently.

6. Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong knowledge of air and sea import freight forwarding operations.
* Excellent understanding of Incoterms 2020.
* Good knowledge of MAWB, HAWB, MBL, HBL and Bills of Entry.
* Understanding of Indian Customs clearance procedures and import documentation.
* Ability to prepare competitive freight quotations independently.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication.
* Strong negotiation, coordination and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and handle multiple shipments.
* Good proficiency in MS Excel, Outlook and freight forwarding ERP systems.
* Strong customer service orientation.
* Commercial awareness and attention to shipment profitability.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

7. Personal Attributes

* Proactive and highly organised.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Customer-focused and service-oriented.
* Excellent communication and follow-up skills.
* Responsible and accountable for assigned shipments.
* Capable of handling urgent and time-sensitive shipments.
* Team player with a positive attitude.
* Committed to meeting deadlines and operational targets.

8. Expected Performance

The successful candidate will be expected to:

* Independently manage assigned air and sea import shipments.
* Provide accurate and timely freight quotations.
* Ensure proactive customer communication.
* Coordinate smooth customs clearance and cargo delivery.
* Minimise avoidable operational delays and additional charges.
* Maintain accurate job costing and support timely invoicing.
* Improve customer retention and enquiry conversion.
* Maintain strong relationships with overseas agents and vendors.
* Ensure consistent compliance with company SOPs and reporting requirements.

9. Position Objective

**To take complete ownership of assigned air and sea import shipments from the initial customer enquiry through quotation, booking, documentation, customs clearance, final delivery and billing, ensuring operational efficiency, customer satisfaction and profitability.**

How to Apply

Interested candidates with a **minimum of 5 years of relevant air and sea freight import experience** may submit their updated CV, mentioning their current CTC, expected CTC, notice period and current location.

**Job Location:** CBD Belapur, Navi Mumbai  
**Company:** Azimar Shipping & Logistics LLP  
**Position:** Import Customer Service Executive – Air & Sea Freight

Recruitment recommendation: For Azimar's CBD Belapur office, prioritise candidates who have independently handled both Mumbai Airport air imports and Nhava Sheva FCL/LCL imports, including freight pricing, customs broker coordination and final delivery. Candidates with only documentation experience, without customer service and operational ownership, would be less suitable for this position.

*Help build the exam and evaluation backbone of a fairer, faster, more trusted India.*

Every year, crores of young Indians walk into an examination hall carrying their family's hopes. What happens to their answer sheet after that — how fairly it is checked, how fast the result comes out, how safely their records are kept — quietly decides the course of their lives.

At **OMR India**, that is our work. And this role is how it reaches every university, institute, board and government office that needs it. **You will not be selling software. You will be selling trust — to the people who hold India's future in their hands.**

▸ **Digital Evaluation** — on-screen marking that is faster, fairer and fully auditable.

▸ **Online & Offline Examination Platforms** — secure assessment at any scale.

▸ **OMR Scanning & Result Processing** — accurate results, delivered on time.

▸ **Document Digitisation** — OMR, OCR and ICR technology that turns paper archives into living data.

description:
**About Energy Exemplar**

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar's mission lies in 'Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions'. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

* *SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.*
* *Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.*
* *IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners*
* *Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category*
* *Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change*
* *Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.*

**How We Work**

Energy Exemplar is growing fast around 30% year on year and, that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that's at home, in the office, or on the move.

We're a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You'll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren't just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

**About the** **Position**

Energy Exemplar is seeking a dynamic, results-driven Sales Director to lead and scale new business acquisition across India. This role holds full ownership of end-to-end new logo sales, playing a critical part in driving regional revenue growth and market expansion.

In this pivotal position, you will define and execute high impact sales strategies focused on direct enterprise sales. You will be responsible for building and maintaining strong, senior-level relationships with key customers, managing complex sales cycles, and driving new business opportunities across the energy and utilities markets.

The Sales Director will ensure Energy Exemplar's solutions are positioned and delivered effectively across the region, aligning closely with customer needs and market dynamics. Success in this role requires a strong commercial mindset, deep experience navigating enterprise sales environments, and the ability to consistently deliver against ambitious growth targets.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* New Business Growth: Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities across India's energy, utilities, and infrastructure sectors.

* Enterprise SaaS Sales: Lead strategic, consultative sales of complex software solutions (e.g., PLEXOS) to senior stakeholders within utilities, independent / transmission system operators, renewable developers, consultants.

* Territory Ownership: Develop and execute a territory strategy tailored to India's unique energy mix, regulatory environment, and market dynamics.

* Stakeholder Engagement: Build strong relationships with C-level executives, policy advisors, planners, and technical teams to position Energy Exemplar as a trusted partner for India's energy transition goals.

* Pipeline Management: Manage the complete sales cycle from discovery to contract close employing best-in-class CRM practices and pipeline discipline.

* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Solutions Engineers, Marketing, Legal, and Product teams to build tailored proposals and deliver against customer-specific requirements.

* Thought Leadership: Represent Energy Exemplar at regional industry conferences, webinars, and policy forums to champion advanced planning, grid modernization, and decarbonization.

* Customer Expansion: Work with Customer Success to drive renewals, upsell opportunities, and expanded adoption across new departments, business units, and modelling use cases.

* Market Awareness: Stay attuned to India's grid evolving energy policy, liberalization efforts, capacity market developments, hydrogen strategies, and competitive landscape across fuels and technologies.

**Candidate Requirements** **& Qualifications**

* 10+ years level of experience in enterprise software/SaaS sales, business development, or consulting in complex, multi-stakeholder environments across India.

* Strong background in the Energy, Utilities, Renewables, or Infrastructure sectors with experience of the Indian market.

* Proven record of achieving and exceeding sales targets across strategic enterprise accounts.

* Must be based in Mumbai, South India, or Delhi NCR, with hybrid working arrangements.

Energy Exemplar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and abilities. Please let us know if you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process—we're here to support you in showcasing your full potential.

About La Densitae

La Densitae Clinic Ltd. is a specialized hair restoration and hair-loss treatment organization committed to delivering quality patient care and a professional healthcare experience. We are looking for a courteous, organized, and patient-focused Front Desk Executive to manage front-office operations and ensure a smooth experience for patients and visitors.

Job Summary

The Front Desk Executive will serve as the first point of contact for patients, visitors, and callers at the clinic. The role involves patient reception, appointment scheduling, handling inquiries, maintaining records, coordinating with internal teams, and supporting daily clinic operations while ensuring excellent customer service.

Roles and Responsibilities

* **Front Desk Management**
* Welcome patients and visitors professionally and ensure a positive first impression.
* Manage patient registration, check-ins, and appointment confirmations.
* Handle incoming calls, emails, and general inquiries efficiently.
* Maintain a professional, organized, and welcoming reception area.
* **Appointment & Patient Coordination**
* Schedule, reschedule, and confirm patient appointments.
* Coordinate with doctors, consultants, and clinic staff to manage patient flow.
* Inform patients about appointment timings and provide necessary pre-visit information.
* Follow up with patients regarding appointments and pending visits, as required.
* **Patient Service & Communication**
* Address patient queries politely and direct medical questions to the appropriate healthcare professional.
* Ensure a smooth and comfortable patient experience throughout the clinic visit.
* Handle patient concerns professionally and escalate complaints to the Branch Manager when necessary.
* Maintain confidentiality of patient information and clinic records.
* **Documentation & Record Management**
* Maintain accurate patient details, appointment records, and visit registers.
* Update patient information in the clinic's software or CRM system.
* Manage documentation, forms, and other front-office records.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of confidential patient documents.
* **Coordination & Administrative Support**
* Coordinate with the sales, consultation, medical, and operations teams.
* Support the Branch Manager with daily administrative activities and reports.
* Assist with billing coordination and payment documentation, wherever required.
* Monitor appointment schedules and help minimize waiting times.
* Follow company policies, standard operating procedures, and service-quality standards.

Required Qualifications

* Graduate in any discipline; candidates with a background in Hospital Administration, Healthcare Management, or Business Administration will be preferred.
* 0–3 years of experience in front desk operations, reception, customer service, or healthcare administration.
* Experience in a clinic, hospital, diagnostic center, or other healthcare facility will be an added advantage.
* Freshers with strong communication and customer-handling skills may also apply.

Required Skills

* Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Professional, polite, and patient-focused approach.
* Basic computer proficiency, including MS Office, email, and data entry.
* Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to multitask and manage appointments efficiently.
* Strong coordination, problem-solving, and customer-service skills.
* Ability to handle confidential information responsibly.
* Fluency in English, Hindi, and Marathi will be preferred.

Working Conditions

* Work from the Thane clinic.
* Six-day working week with one weekly off, as per clinic schedule.
* Working hours will be as per clinic timings.
* The candidate must be comfortable working in a patient-facing healthcare environment.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Patient satisfaction and quality of front-desk service.
* Accuracy of patient records and appointment scheduling.
* Timely handling of calls and patient inquiries.
* Effective coordination with doctors and clinic teams.
* Reduction in appointment-related errors and patient waiting time.
* Compliance with clinic policies and documentation standards.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a well-groomed, approachable, and service-oriented individual who can manage front-desk responsibilities efficiently, communicate confidently with patients, and contribute to the smooth functioning of clinic operations.

* Track pending customer requests and ensure timely follow-ups with the respective internal teams.

* Update customer interactions, meeting notes, service requirements, and follow-up details.
* Organize and maintain customer documentation, agreements, and operational records.
* Track ongoing customer requests and ensure proper closure and documentation.
* Prepare regular operational updates and reports for Senior BDMs and management.

* Follow up internally on service activations, modifications, renewals, and customer requests.
* Ensure smooth communication between customers and internal departments.
* Track pending tasks and escalate delays to the respective Senior BDM or department.
* Assist in resolving operational bottlenecks and improving coordination between teams.

**5. Customer Service & Operational Support**

* Support existing customers with service-related requests and documentation.
* Coordinate customer onboarding and ensure required information is collected and shared internally.
* Maintain trackers for customer requests, pending approvals, and service-related activities.
* Ensure timely responses and updates to customers.
* Support process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and customer experience.

* Fresh graduates with strong communication and coordination skills are encouraged to apply.

* Good organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Customer-handling and relationship-management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and Google Workspace.

* Customer onboarding and service coordination.
* Cross-functional communication and operational management.
* Professional customer communication and issue escalation.

* Learn how customer operations work in a technology-driven organization.

title: Senior Executive - Buying & Merchandising (Footwear)
description:
The Senior Executive – Buying, Merchandising & Product Development will support the seasonal range planning, assortment building, buying and merchandising activities, product performance analysis, EOSS planning, and product development initiatives for the Footwear category at Skechers India.  
The role will work closely with the Buying & Merchandising, Product Development, Planning, Marketing, Retail Operations, Visual Merchandising, and other cross-functional teams to ensure the right product, assortment, quantity, timing, pricing and channel mix are delivered in line with business objectives.  
The position will also be responsible for monitoring category and product performance at the store, region, channel, gender, style and size level, identifying opportunities and supporting corrective actions to maximise sales, sell-through, inventory productivity and profitability.

**Designation:** Senior Executive

**Role:** Buying & Merchandising

**Department:** Category - Footwear

**Position:** Permanent

**Location:** Mumbai

**Reporting To:** Deputy General Manager - B&M

Individual Contributor role

**KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Season Range Planning & Assortment Building**

* Support the development of **seasonal footwear ranges** based on business objectives, historical performance, market trends and consumer requirements.
* Analyse previous-season performance to identify **winning styles, underperforming products, gaps and opportunities** for the upcoming season.
* Support assortment planning across **categories, gender, product types, price points, technologies, franchises and channels**.
* Assist in determining the optimum width and depth of assortment based on store grades, regional requirements and channel potential.
* Support the development of **OTB and buy recommendations** in line with business plans.
* Ensure the assortment is balanced across core, fashion, seasonal and newness products.
* Participate in seasonal range reviews and product selection meetings with relevant stakeholders.

**2. Buying & Merchandise Planning**

* Support the Buying Manager/Senior Manager in developing the seasonal buying plan for the assigned category.
* Prepare and maintain **buy forms, assortment sheets, range plans, catalogues and other buying-related documents**.
* Track planned versus actual buys and highlight significant deviations.
* Monitor product availability and ensure adequate inventory coverage for key styles and periods.
* Coordinate with Planning and Supply Chain teams to ensure product availability as per the agreed seasonal calendar.
* Support decisions related to **replenishment, stock balancing, liquidation and inventory movement** based on product performance.
* Monitor inventory ageing and identify potential risks to minimise excess and obsolete inventory.

**3. Season Launch & Delivery Tracking**

* Take ownership of tracking **seasonal product deliveries** for the respective category.
* Maintain detailed trackers for planned, received and pending deliveries.
* Coordinate with relevant internal teams to identify and resolve delays or gaps impacting season launches.
* Ensure key launches are aligned with the agreed **Go-To-Market calendar**.
* Highlight delivery risks and provide timely updates to the Buying/Merchandising leadership team.
* Support cross-functional teams in ensuring that new-season products are available in stores within the planned launch timelines.

**4. Product Performance & Sell-Through Management**

* Conduct periodic, in-depth analysis of category performance across:
  + Region
  + Store grade
  + Store/channel
  + Category
  + Gender
  + Product/style
  + Size
  + Price point
  + Season
* Monitor **sales, sell-through, stock cover, inventory levels, ageing, markdowns and profitability**.
* Identify top-performing and underperforming styles and recommend appropriate actions.
* Analyse store-level performance and identify assortment gaps or over/under-stock situations.
* Support initiatives to improve **full-price sell-through and inventory productivity**.
* Provide regular performance dashboards and actionable insights to the Buying & Merchandising team.
* Track agreed **GM% and category profitability deliverables** and highlight areas requiring corrective action.

**5. EOSS & Markdown Planning**

* Support the Buying Manager in planning and executing **End of Season Sale (EOSS)** activities.
* Analyse ageing and slow-moving inventory to identify products requiring markdown or liquidation.
* Support markdown recommendations based on product performance, inventory position, store/channel and seasonality.
* Monitor EOSS performance and sell-through during the sale period.
* Track inventory liquidation and identify opportunities to minimise carry-forward stock.
* Prepare post-EOSS analysis and recommendations for future seasons.

**6. Product Development**

* Support **new product development initiatives** for key channels, strategic partners and specific market opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal Product Development/Design teams and other stakeholders for product briefs, specifications and development timelines.
* Conduct market and competitor analysis to identify **product gaps, consumer trends and emerging opportunities**.
* Support development of products based on channel/customer requirements while maintaining Skechers brand standards.
* Assist in tracking product development milestones from **concept/brief through sampling, approval and finalisation**.
* Coordinate feedback on samples, specifications, colourways, materials, pricing and commercial viability.
* Maintain product development trackers and ensure timelines are adhered to.
* Support the development of commercially viable products with the right balance of **consumer relevance, brand fit, price point and margin**.

**7. Product Knowledge & Training**

* Conduct seasonal **product conferences and product knowledge sessions** in coordination with relevant teams.
* Develop product knowledge and understanding among store teams, including:
  + Product features
  + Technologies
  + Key selling points
  + Consumer benefits
  + Product differentiation
  + Target consumer
* Work with Retail Operations and L&D teams to ensure effective communication of new-season product information.
* Support creation and dissemination of product training material and product information.

**8. Marketing & Visual Merchandising Support**

* Work closely with Marketing and Visual Merchandising teams to align product launches with the **seasonal marketing calendar**.
* Support key marketing initiatives and product-focused campaigns.
* Provide product information and key selling propositions required for marketing communication.
* Assist in developing **merchandise display plans** for new-season products.
* Coordinate with Visual Merchandising and Retail Operations to ensure appropriate product presentation in stores.
* Support key launches and campaigns through timely availability of products and relevant product information.

**9. Store & Regional Performance Analysis**

* Conduct regular reviews of product performance across stores and regions.
* Identify variations in performance based on **store grade, geography, channel and consumer profile**.
* Recommend assortment adjustments based on regional and store-level trends.
* Identify size-level gaps and recommend appropriate size curves for future buys.
* Analyse store-level sell-through to identify opportunities for stock transfers, replenishment or assortment optimisation.
* Partner with Retail Operations and regional teams to understand market feedback and translate insights into merchandising actions.

**10. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with **Buying, Merchandising, Planning, Product Development, Supply Chain, Marketing, Visual Merchandising, Retail Operations, Finance and other relevant teams**.
* Ensure timely communication of category plans, product launches, delivery status and performance insights.
* Participate in regular business reviews and provide relevant data and recommendations.
* Ensure alignment between product strategy, inventory availability and commercial objectives.
* Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners/vendors, wherever required.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**

The role will be measured on:

* Seasonal range planning and assortment effectiveness
* Category sales achievement
* Sell-through % and full-price sell-through
* GM% / gross margin delivery
* Inventory productivity and stock cover
* New-season launch and delivery adherence
* EOSS sell-through and liquidation
* Reduction in aged/excess inventory
* Style and size-level productivity
* New product development timelines
* Product launch readiness
* Store and regional assortment effectiveness
* Accuracy and timeliness of MIS/analysis
* Effectiveness of cross-functional execution

**ROLE SPECIFICATIONS**

**Qualification**

* Graduate from **FDDI (Footwear Design & Development Institute)** preferred.
* Degree/Diploma in Footwear, Fashion, Retail, Merchandising or a related discipline will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* **Minimum 4 years of relevant experience** in Buying & Merchandising, preferably within the **footwear, fashion, sportswear, lifestyle or retail industry**.
* Experience in seasonal range planning, assortment building and product performance analysis.
* Exposure to product development and working with cross-functional teams will be preferred.

Experience in a multi-store retail environment would be an advantage.

**CORE COMPETENCIES**

**Functional Competencies**

* Season range planning and assortment building
* Buying & merchandise planning
* Sell-through management
* Category performance management
* Inventory and stock productivity
* EOSS and markdown planning
* Style and size-level analysis
* Store and regional performance analysis
* GM% and margin management
* Product development
* Product lifecycle management
* Market and competitor analysis
* Product knowledge and training
* Merchandise display planning

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Strong analytical and numerical ability
* Commercial acumen
* Customer and consumer orientation
* Strong attention to detail
* Planning and execution skills
* Ability to work with multiple stakeholders
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Problem-solving and decision-making ability
* Ownership and accountability
* Ability to work in a fast-paced retail environment
* Collaborative and team-oriented approach

**Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in **MS Excel**, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, charts and data analysis.
* Good understanding of merchandising reports and retail KPIs.
* Exposure to ERP/retail merchandising systems would be an advantage.
* Ability to prepare management reports, dashboards and presentations using **Excel and PowerPoint**.

**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**

**Internal:**  
Buying & Merchandising | Planning | Product Development | Retail Operations | Marketing | Visual Merchandising | Supply Chain | Finance | HR/L&D

**External:**  
Vendors | Product Development Partners | Strategic Channel/Business Partners | Other relevant external stakeholders

**IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE**

The ideal candidate should have a strong combination of **merchandising expertise, commercial understanding, analytical capability and product orientation**. The candidate should be comfortable working with large volumes of product and store-level data, translating insights into actionable buying and merchandising decisions, and collaborating with multiple teams to deliver seasonal business objectives.

Experience in the **footwear or sportswear industry** would be highly preferred, with an understanding of product technologies, consumer preferences, retail dynamics, seasonal buying cycles and product lifecycle management.

**About Skechers**

Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

Location: Mumbai (Multiple Premium Sales Gallery Locations)

**Job Purpose**

The Hospitality Manager is responsible for leading end-to-end hospitality operations across premium luxury real estate sales galleries. This role ensures the delivery of exceptional, personalized guest experiences that mirror internationally recognized five-star luxury hotel standards. By overseeing guest-facing operations, team leadership, service excellence, vendor management, and operational efficiency, the Hospitality Manager elevates the customer journey, strengthens brand image, and creates memorable experiences for HNI, UHNI, NRI, celebrity, and VIP visitors.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities**

  
  

**1. Guest Experience Leadership**

* Design and deliver an exceptional guest journey from arrival to departure.
* Ensure every visitor receives personalized, warm, and professional service aligned with luxury hospitality standards.
* Develop memorable experiences for HNI, UHNI, NRI investors, celebrities, and VIP guests.
* Personally oversee all VIP visits and high-profile customer engagements.
* Resolve guest concerns promptly with professionalism and discretion.
* Monitor guest feedback and implement continuous service improvement initiatives.
  

  

**2. Hospitality Operations Management**

* Provide strategic leadership for all hospitality functions including Front Office, Reception, Guest Relations, Concierge, Butler Services, Pantry & Refreshment Operations, Food & Beverage, Housekeeping, Lounge Management, Meeting Rooms, Boardrooms, and Event Hospitality.
* Maintain impeccable presentation and luxury hotel standards across all areas.
  

  

**3. Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, inspire, and develop a high-performing team of Guest Relations Executives, Reception Associates, Concierge Associates, Butler Team, Pantry Associates, Housekeeping Supervisors, Housekeeping Associates, and support staff.
* Handle recruitment, onboarding, performance management, training, grooming & etiquette coaching, shift planning, employee engagement, and succession planning.
* Foster a culture of service excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  

  

**4. Luxury Service Excellence**

* Maintain uncompromising standards in Guest Welcome, Service Etiquette, Grooming, Uniforms, Floral Décor, Ambient Music, Fragrance Management, Food & Beverage Presentation, Lounge Ambience, Washroom Excellence, and Public Area Cleanliness.
* Conduct regular service audits and coaching sessions to ensure consistency.
  

  

**5. Food & Beverage Management**

* Oversee premium pantry and refreshment operations with focus on presentation, inventory management, product quality, food safety, vendor coordination, cost control, and wastage minimization.
  

  

**6. Vendor & Service Partner Management**

* Manage vendors for Housekeeping, Security, Pest Control, HVAC, Landscaping, Floral Services, Coffee Machines, Water Purification, Consumables, and Waste Management.
* Monitor performance through SLAs, periodic reviews, and quality audits.
  

  

**7. Facility Coordination**

* Collaborate with technical teams to ensure uninterrupted operations of HVAC, Electrical, Plumbing, Carpentry, Lighting, and Preventive Maintenance systems.
* Maintain full operational readiness of the sales gallery at all times.
* Maintain AMC and Service Records and follow-up timely services
* Facilitate breakdown recovery by handymen services or authroised vendor partners
  

  

**8. Financial & Inventory Management**

**9. Quality Assurance & Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to SOPs, Brand Standards, Safety & Hygiene protocols, and Operational Checklists.
* Conduct audits and implement corrective actions.
  

  

**10. Reporting & Management Information**

* Prepare Daily Operations Reports, Weekly Dashboards, Guest Feedback Analysis, Incident Reports, Vendor Reviews, Budget Reports, and Monthly Hospitality Scorecards.
* Provide data-driven recommendations for improvement.
  

  

**Educational Qualifications**

Bachelor’s Degree in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or Tourism Management. Master’s Degree or PG in Hospitality Management is preferred.

Experience

TrueVolt is building an open marketplace for smartphones, electronics, accessories and related products.

We connect local retailers and sellers with customers looking to purchase products in their area. Our platform helps sellers not only list their inventory but also generate sales by making their products discoverable to nearby customers through the TrueVolt app.

We are now expanding our seller network across major cities in India and are looking for energetic, target-driven people to join our Sales & Business Development team.

About the Role

As a **Business Development Executive for Seller Acquisition**, you will be responsible for expanding TrueVolt's seller network in your assigned city.

Your primary responsibility will be to identify potential sellers, visit their stores, explain the TrueVolt platform, onboard them, and build a strong relationship with them.

This is a **field sales role**, so you should be comfortable spending most of your working day in the market meeting shop owners and business owners.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and map potential sellers, retailers and mobile/electronics stores in your assigned territory.
* Visit shops and meet business owners / decision-makers.
* Introduce TrueVolt and explain how the platform can help sellers generate additional sales.
* Acquire and onboard new sellers onto the TrueVolt platform.
* Explain the seller onboarding process, platform features and commercial terms.
* Collect and verify required seller/business information and documents.
* Maintain regular follow-ups with prospective sellers and convert leads into active sellers.
* Build strong relationships with onboarded sellers.
* Help sellers understand how to effectively use the TrueVolt platform.
* Maintain daily activity and sales reports.
* Achieve weekly and monthly seller acquisition targets.
* Identify new market opportunities and competitor activity.
* Work closely with the TrueVolt operations and growth teams to improve seller acquisition and activation.

What We Are Looking For

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable speaking with shop owners and business professionals.
* Good convincing and negotiation ability.
* Self-motivated and target-oriented.
* Comfortable with field work and travelling within the assigned city.
* Ability to independently identify and approach potential sellers.
* Basic knowledge of smartphones, electronics, mobile accessories or retail is an advantage.
* Prior experience in field sales, merchant acquisition, B2B sales, retail sales or business development is preferred.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and a sales mindset are also welcome.

Who Will Do Well in This Role?

This role is ideal for someone who:

* Enjoys meeting new people every day.
* Is comfortable approaching businesses directly.
* Doesn't hesitate to make cold calls or walk into stores.
* Can convince a business owner to try a new platform.
* Enjoys working with targets and incentives.
* Takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions.
* Wants to grow in a fast-moving startup environment.

Performance Metrics

Your performance will primarily be measured on:

* New seller acquisition
* Seller activation
* Daily/weekly market visits
* Lead-to-onboarding conversion
* Active sellers generated
* Monthly sales/business targets

Compensation

**Salary:** ₹15000 – ₹30000 per month  
**Performance Incentives:** Additional incentives based on seller acquisition and performance.

**Total earning potential:** Salary + attractive performance-based incentives.

*Compensation can be structured based on experience and performance.*

Growth Opportunity

TrueVolt is expanding across multiple cities in India.

High-performing team members can grow into roles such as:

**Business Development Executive → Senior BDE → City Sales Manager → Regional Sales Manager**

This is an opportunity to join the early sales team and play a direct role in building TrueVolt's seller network across India.

How to Apply

If you are energetic, ambitious, comfortable with field sales and excited about building something from the ground up, we'd like to hear from you.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

**Job summary**

As a Sales Analyst in the Payments Corporate Sales team, you will be responsible for providing support to the Payments Sales Managers covering various industries to manage client relationships and drive sales. This encompasses client and market intelligence for new and existing clients along with supporting the sales team's various requirements, such as managing pipeline report, deal execution, pricing and fee billing support, preparing client pitching materials and other related matters. This position also provides an excellent opportunity to obtain front office experience interacting with clients, corporate bankers, product, client service, implementation and other functions. * Assist the Sales team with sales pitch materials, RFP/RFI submissions, and preparation of proposals for internal approvals. Build and understand pricing and profitability models.
* Conduct research on existing client portfolios and prospective clients. Prepare client research, industry analysis, and provide fundamental research on market sizing by region.
* Review and analyze transactional data to identify key trends, risks, and pricing/billing inefficiencies.
* Support the end-to-end sales cycle, including client onboarding, pricing, fee billing setup, and deal execution. Understand client account structures, cash flow, product usage, and regional/global setups.

* Partner internal teams in their client account planning process

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Minimum of 2 years of professional experience
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex problems into concise conclusions.
* Goal-driven and results-oriented, with the ability to foster innovation and solve problems creatively.
* Excellent time management, organizational, and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and ensure follow-up coordination.

* Ability to mobilize internal networks and resources effectively.
* Aspiration to develop sales and technical skills for a future Sales/Business Development role.
* Results oriented. Able to work under pressure within tight timeframes.

* Minimum Bachelor's degree or equivalent.

* Cash management experience preferred

title: Sales specialist Panel Builder
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.



This Position reports to:



Sales Manager \#\#\#


**What we believe in**



At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration \- combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities \- are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.


**Your role and responsibilities**



In this role, you will have the opportunity to be responsible for the sales of products/systems/services within a designated market/division, in line with the division strategy. Each day, you will meet both qualitative and quantitative sales targets to ensure sustainable order growth, revenues, profitability, market share, and customer satisfaction. You will also showcase your skills by identifying and developing new sales opportunities.



The work model for the role is: \#Li\-Onsite



The role will support for the ABB India Ltd for Electrification Smart Buildings Business to be based at Mumbai, India.


**You will be mainly accountable for:**


* Communicate with customers regarding delivery timelines, payments, and terms in alignment with ABB’s strategy while ensuring a positive customer experience throughout the sales process.
* Facilitate marketing initiatives, promote ABB’s value proposition, and identify new market opportunities to expand business reach.
* Manage sales administration, support cash collection, and coordinate with project management to ensure smooth execution of orders.
* Build productive relationships with panel builders and industrial end users with experience in the Mumbai market


**Qualifications for the role:**


* Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Electrical / Electronic Engineering.
* Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in sales or business development within the electrical industry.
* Proficient in building and maintaining long\-term relationships with customers by addressing their needs and ensuring satisfaction.
* Experience in handling panel builders and industrial end users, with extensive exposure to the Mumbai market.
* Skilled communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills to enhance customer engagement and business growth.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across divisions and countries, promoting knowledge sharing and teamwork.
* Customer\-focused mindset with a history of resolving complex issues and delivering value\-added solutions.


**More about us**



ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.



Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.



Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
